name: Kosovo

flag.description: A blue field with a gold map of Kosovo in the center, under an arc of six white five-pointed stars.
flag.symbolism: The six stars are commonly said to represent Kosovo's main ethnic communities; the blue, gold and stars echo the flag of Europe.

hook: A golden map under an arc of six white stars on blue: Kosovo shows its own outline like Cyprus, but on blue instead of white.
trivia: Kosovo and Cyprus are the only countries whose flags show a map of their territory.
The flag was chosen through a public design competition in 2008 and avoids the symbols of any single ethnic group.
